environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Flask app runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080, ELB forwards to 8080. Database is local SQLite file. Instance role has no special permissions. Standard Amazon Linux 2 AMI.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener mode (no HTTP inspection)
